# Off Duty SOP This is the list of procedures, responsibilities, and duties of the [color=#776d66][bold]Off Duty[/bold][/color] personnel of this station.
We at Nanotrasen hope you enjoy your time off. Enjoy the many amenities and facilities on your station — you deserve them!
1. Off Duty personnel are free to spend their time as they please. However, on [color=#ba292c]Red Alert[/color] or higher, you are encouraged to return to duty.
[color=#8a3324]Amber Alert[/color] requires you by contract to return to duty. If it is called, report to the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Personnel[/bold][/color] to restore your departmental access.
2. Off Duty personnel are not permitted to carry departmental equipment; it will be treated as contraband.
If you wish to use your department's equipment, request a permit from the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Personnel[/bold][/color].
3. To return to duty, Off Duty personnel must first confirm if they are needed with their department's Head of Staff, then report to the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Personnel[/bold][/color] to restore their departmental access.
